trace_target.label: Story 7.4: Invariante — preview nunca altera o spawn

requirements.title: 60/40 display decision never alters materialized spawn — placed tile always equals pre-resolved pendingSpawn.value (N3 invariant, FR-44)

tests.title: [P0] AC1 sweep — previewFor never mutates pending and branch kind correct across FULL × displayRoll × POT-only availabilities
[P0] AC1 materialization left — display decision never alters placed tile (exact and range)
[P0] AC1 materialization up — display decision never alters placed tile (directional candidates up)

requirements.title: Invariant across full distribution — exact, ambiguous-1/2 (1|2→[1,2]), ambiguous-3 ([3]→[3]), ambiguous-range (3/6, 3/6/12 etc. with larger pots) — FR-44

tests.title: [P0] AC2 sweep — range always contains valued truth and is contiguous (FULL × POT-only availabilities)
[P0] AC2 FR-44 — value 1 ambiguous with [3] yields [1,2]
[P0] AC2 FR-44 — value 2 ambiguous with [3] yields [1,2]
[P0] AC2 FR-44 — value 3 ambiguous with [3] yields [3]
[P0] AC2 FR-44 — value 3 ambiguous with [3,6,12] yields [3,6,12]
[P0] AC2 FR-44 — value 6 ambiguous with [3,6,12,24] yields [6,12,24]

requirements.title: Undo rewinds preview with board — pendingSpawn lives in immutable snapshot so rewinding restores both board and preview together (ADR-06, state-placement master rule)

tests.title: [P0] AC3 7.4 isolation — shallow-copy keeps snapshot independent; mutating result never rewrites prior history
[P0] AC3 7.4 snapshot carries preview — reconstructing GameState from result deterministically replays next move
[P0] AC3 7.4 noop — full immovable board returns pending deepEqual, 0 draws, no spawned entry, trace length 16
[P0] AC3 7.4 direction-agnostic — snapshot carries preview for left (row) and up (column) equally

requirements.title: Preview never influences spawn position, spawn value, or spawn timing — FR-44 (position directional candidates, value place-not-roll, timing effective-move only)

tests.title: [P0] AC4 value — same board and pending.value but different displayRoll yields identical spawn cell and value (displayRoll never flows into spawnTile)
[P0] AC4 position — previewFor output never supplies candidates; candidates derived only from shiftLine.moved opposite-edge
[P0] AC4 timing — previewFor consumes 0 draws by construction; effective move 3 draws, noop 0 draws

requirements.title: Changing display logic requires no change to spawn resolver — N3 separation: preview.ts never imports roll symbols and spawn.ts/game.ts never import preview (structural boundary)

tests.title: [P0] AC5 structural boundary — preview.ts never imports roll symbols and never uses Math.random; engine never imports preview
[P0] AC5 purity — previewFor is pure and RANGE_1_2 frozen identity retained
